answer: Sybil farmers beat per-identity prices by sampling: spawn a hundred shells, harvest the lucky ten, abandon the rest — survivor bias is the reef where entry-fee defenses wreck. Anchor rewards to the funding-provenance cluster instead of the identity: the ledger mirrors every identity back to the wallet that funded it, and a cluster's aggregate payout is capped at what a single honest identity could earn. Cloning multiplies work but never multiplies reward, so the farm's whole edge — cheap abandonment — pays nothing extra.
